run_train_net: run the TensorMask training script with detectron2 config files and GPU arguments
build_trainer_evaluator: build a COCOEvaluator for the TensorMask Trainer class with a specified dataset name
setup_config: create and freeze a detectron2 config merged from a TensorMask config file and CLI options
test_model_eval: test a TensorMask model by loading checkpoint weights and running evaluation on a dataset
train_model: train a TensorMask model using the Trainer class with resume support and distributed launch
